auditor_kim: Hi folks — parallel fieldwork for SOC2: can you assemble a single one-page control pack for INC-6187654321 that proves: 1) RBAC rollback/remediation timeline (actor, change, timestamp), 2) KMS rotation and cryptographic linkage showing post-rotation ciphertexts reference the promoted version, 3) immutable artifact snapshot + sha256 + signed manifest, and 4) short vuln triage summary and evidence links. Need exact file paths and short audit queries we can paste into the binder.

jess: We can do that. Plan: produce terraform plan/apply diff (redacted), CloudAudit/CloudTrail snippets for IAM and KMS, an archived WORM copy of the bundle, bundle.sha256, manifest.json + manifest.json.sig (GPG-signed), and triage.md. All objects under s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/. Will include presigned GETs (48h) for the auditor.

arjun: RBAC detail: rolebinding removal was executed via terraform apply at 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z by ops@redwood.com. Remote-state diff exported. CloudTrail query we used:
```
filter eventName in (DetachRolePolicy, DeleteRolePolicy) and eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:00:00Z" and eventTime <= "2025-03-14T09:10:00Z"
```
Exported events -> s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/iam-events.json.gz (event ids: 79a2b3c4-... , 88d9e7f0-...). Terraform diff file at s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/terraform-diff.txt (secrets redacted). Sample terraform snippet: 
```
- resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "svc_readonly" {
-   role       = "svc-pod-readonly"
-   policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
- }
+ (removed)
apply timestamp: 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z
```

jess: KMS: CMK alias "alias/serving-cmk" promoted version v7 at 2025-03-14T09:12:03Z. We captured Encrypt/ReEncrypt CloudTrail entries where requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId ends with ":7" for post-rotation writes. Exported to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/kms-events.jsonl. Short CloudTrail snippet (redacted):
```
{
  eventTime: "2025-03-14T09:12:05Z",
  eventName: "Encrypt",
  userIdentity: { arn: "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ops-role/ops" },
  requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789:7" }
}
```
Sample ciphertext envelope metadata we captured on post-rotation uploads (redacted):
```
-----CIPHERTEXT-ENVELOPE-----
x-amz-meta-kms-key-arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
x-amz-meta-kms-key-version: 7
-----END ENVELOPE-----
```
This will show cryptographic linkage to version 7 for ciphertexts written after promote.

arjun: Snapshot and tamper-proofing: bundle.tar.gz was copied to s3://redwood-worm/6187654321/bundle.tar.gz using Object Lock (Governance) with a 365-day retention set at copy-time. Sidecar file s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/bundle.tar.gz.sha256 stores the ASCII checksum. Manifest list at s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/manifest.json (filenames + sha256s), signed to manifest.json.sig by ops GPG key. Signed manifest uploaded at s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/manifest.json.sig. ops GPG fingerprint: 7E5A F2C3 D1B4 9A88 0123 4DEF 5678 9ABC A1B2 C3D4 (key id 0xA1B2C3D4).

ops-archive-bot: auto-export: uploaded iam-events.json.gz (sha256: bc1f2d...), kms-events.jsonl (sha256: f0d3a9...), terraform-diff.txt (sha256: a9b8c7...), manifest.json.sig (signed-by: ops@redwood.com, sha256: e4f1b2...). WORM copy: s3://redwood-worm/6187654321/bundle.tar.gz (object-lock: Governance, retention-until: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z). Presigned GETs created (48h): manifest: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/manifest.json.sig?X, bundle: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-worm/6187654321/bundle.tar.gz?Y.

jess: Vulnerability triage summary: INC-6187654321/triage.md attached. Short: CVE-2025-1234 in base image redwood/serving:2.7.7; assessed high; remediation = rebuild base image (v2.7.8) + rolling restart; fix applied and deploy completed at 2025-03-14T09:45:00Z. Deploy logs and rollout events exported to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/deploy-log.txt.gz.

auditor_kim: Two small asks before I file this: 1) please paste one redacted CloudTrail Encrypt event that includes destinationKeyVersionId ":7" and one terraform diff line with timestamp (you partially did but paste the exact lines I can copy/paste), 2) include a one-paragraph control map (plain text) I can drop into the binder including Control ID, Incident ID, What changed, Evidence files (paths + hashes), Audit queries (copyable), Retention/WORM details, Crypto assertions (GPG fingerprint + KMS key ARN+version), Redactions, and Owner contact.

jess: I'll drop the control map below as plain text (one paragraph + bullet-style evidence list) for the binder. Keep in mind presigned links expire in 48h.

jess: CONTROL MAP ENTRY (plain text):
Control ID: SR-INC-2025-03-14-01 | Incident ID: INC-6187654321.
What changed: RBAC rolebinding removal and service account key rotation following investigation of compromised pod; CMK alias/serving-cmk promoted to version 7 and artifacts re-encrypted/archived.
Evidence files (paths + hashes):
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/terraform-diff.txt (sha256: a9b8c7...), exported plan/apply showing RBAC removal; apply timestamp 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z.
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/iam-events.json.gz (sha256: bc1f2d...), CloudTrail IAM events (event ids: 79a2b3c4..., 88d9e7f0...).
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/kms-events.jsonl (sha256: f0d3a9...), CloudTrail Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries showing destinationKeyVersionId ending in :7 (sample event pasted above).
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/manifest.json.sig (sha256: e4f1b2...), GPG-signed manifest of exported bundle; ops GPG fingerprint: 7E5A F2C3 D1B4 9A88 0123 4DEF 5678 9ABC A1B2 C3D4 (key id 0xA1B2C3D4).
- s3://redwood-worm/6187654321/bundle.tar.gz (retention-locked until 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z) and adjacent s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/bundle.tar.gz.sha256 (ASCII checksum).
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/triage.md and s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6187654321/deploy-log.txt.gz (vuln triage and remediation logs; fix applied 2025-03-14T09:45:00Z).
Audit queries (copy/paste):
- IAM/CloudTrail: filter eventName in (DetachRolePolicy, DeleteRolePolicy) and eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:00:00Z" and eventTime <= "2025-03-14T09:10:00Z"
- KMS/CloudTrail: filter eventName in (Encrypt, ReEncrypt) and requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId endswith ":7" and eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:12:00Z"
Verification steps: download manifest.json.sig, verify signature with ops public key (gpg --keyserver keys.redwood.com --recv-keys 0xA1B2C3D4; gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json), download bundle.tar.gz and run sha256sum to compare to bundle.tar.gz.sha256, grep kms-events.jsonl for ":7" entries to confirm post-rotation ciphertexts reference version 7, match terraform-diff.txt apply timestamp to iam-events.json.gz entries.
Retention/WORM details: bundle.tar.gz copied to redwood-worm bucket with Object Lock (Governance mode) and retention set to 365 days (retention-until: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z); other evidence files retained per evidence retention policy (365 days).
Cryptographic assertions: ops GPG fingerprint 7E5A F2C3 D1B4 9A88 0123 4DEF 5678 9ABC A1B2 C3D4 (key id 0xA1B2C3D4); KMS key ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789, promoted version 7 referenced in ciphertexts.
Redactions: terraform-diff.txt redacted for account IDs and secrets; cloud audit exports contain redacted principal identifiers where required.
Owner: Security Engineering (owners: jess@redwood.com, arjun@redwood.com). Contact: security-oncall@redwood.com.

auditor_kim: This is perfect 44d. I will drop this into the SOC2 binder. Please ensure the presigned GETs are live for 48 hours. Can you confirm ops GPG public key is available on keys.redwood.com?
